policy: Development only before held-out outcome inspection. Keep trials, task-matched controls, failures and incomplete arms. Never impute missing measurements. Count unsuccessful attempts in cost. No extra spending after a per-arm bound; report denominator. Labels are scoring-only. Historical November 1 results separate.
split: offline local multi-tool, all_tools distractor variant; group by underlying template including alt/implicit variants. Split by base family SHA256 mod 5 (0 = dev); published 72 local tickets separately
measure: stateful task pass, wrong side effects, shown schema tokens per attempt, paired interval
guard: maximum 5 candidate schemas; same actor and tools, no reference action sequence; same step limits; require more completed and no increased unsafe actions
budget: 20 model turns, <=800 output tokens each, 10 USD per arm; note numerical representation used
